title: Midnight Drops

lyrics:
[Intro]
[Soft rain sound begins]
[Gentle rhythmic tapping]
[Slow
Deep breath in... and out]

[Verse]
[Whispering]
The world is quiet now
The shadows start to fade
Listen to the glass
Watch the patterns that the rain has made
[Soft humming]
Mmm

[Chorus]
[Very soft singing
Breathy]
Drift away drift away
Let the static wash away
Heavy eyes peaceful mind
Leave the waking world behind
[Tapping on wood]

[Close-mic whisper]
Focus on the sound
Just the water falling down
You are safe You are warm
Safe inside the gentle storm

[Bridge]
[Layered whispers]
Slowly softly
Drifting dreaming
[Distant thunder rolling gently]
Nothing else matters right now
